purpose: Non-transcribable owner-oracle layer. The active perturbation is read from the committed content of the selector input file(s), never from an out-of-band flag. A memorized/copied-template answer that is correct only for the baseline (unperturbed) packet must FAIL when a different perturbation is active, because the perturbed-correct decision is textually different from the baseline-correct decision.

selector.detection: sha256 of each selector input file's current bytes must match exactly one perturbation entry's input_snapshots map; no match is a hard verifier error (unrecognized/drifted inputs state).
